notes.title: 50Years Alpha0.3 UPDATE!
notes.content:
When you access Steam, you will find some updates. 
The patch contents make notifications including small updates.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Added contents:
- We have added medals.
  Medals are awarded and displayed on the soldier information section
  when you achieve a record.
- Medal information has been included in the tip column.
- You can check five best capabilities of allies and enemies in the battle field. 
- A sleeping bag button has been added on the construction book.
  A sleeping bag raises a soldier’s fighting spirit every year.

Bugs fixed: 
- The therapist’s treatment bug has been fixed and the impact of treatment 
  has been added.
- We’ve fixed the problem of disposing the bones of dead allies in the strategy book, as they used to be disposed together with other skeletons. 
- We’ve fixed the problem of transferring the 1st ally on the 2nd page to the Corps, as it used to transfer the 16th ally on the 1st page instead. 
- We’ve edited the actions of the unit which only charged against the exterior  walls of the city.

Modifications: 
- In clan selection, the capability of an initial-stage clan member
  has changed to reflect the finances. 
 Choosing a clan with smaller finances increases the capability of the initial- stage clan member.	
- Every ten years, you will be charged by an enemy with strong capabilities.  
- The annual income of soldiers in the existing version has been 
  increased by more than tenfold.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*The medal functions will be added on next update.
*I’ve been receiving inquiries about using my product. For all tutorial inquiries, please refer to the second video on the Steam shop which provides you a simple tutorial about the game.

Regarding other inquiries, please e-mail to jinsimer@naver.com.
This was Jinsimer.

notes.title: Alpha 0.2 ver UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hello. This is Jinsimer.
I should've updated the notice when released, but I'm updating it now.
"50years" has been updated to Alpha 0.2 version.

Alpha 0.2ver
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Added contents.
- TIP is added.
  You can read detailed capacity of a soldier.
  Click the blue book.
-"Legend" function has been added.
  Once you reach a certain rank, you ascend to the "Legend" in clan.
  The information of "Legend" remains at a wall beside the bed.

Fixed bugs
- Our forces' "Boo-man" job's boomerang bug has been fixed.
- The enemy's "Boo-man" job's boomerang bug has also been fixed.
- Memory overload after Gray shields' death has been fixed.

Changed points
-The original maximum clan members' number has been changed from 16 to   32. You can turn over the next page at strategy book.
-Tired soldiers will be marked on battlefield as well.
-When you put your cursor close to strategy book, construction book and tip book, vitalization line will be drawn.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

There are still many bugs that hasn't been fixed. Bugs will be fixed at every update and tips will be added to tip book at every update.
Regarding other inquiries, please e-mail to jinsimer@naver.com.
This was Jinsimer.
